title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Tengchong, 20–22 March, 2015–2025
claims: For Tengchong on 20–22 March in 2015–2025 there are 33 daily records: daily maximum 16.2–26.9 °C (median 21.6 °C), daily minimum 4.1–11.1 °C (median 7.9 °C), 10 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 4 days with at least 5 mm.
The station is Tengchong city, not the Gaoligong ridge at 2,000–3,000 m.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 20–22 March; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.
